---
title: Stat 1080 - Data and the Stories They Tell
format: html
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
source("schedule.R")
library(DT)
scheduletbl |>
  group_by(Week, weeksort, `Week Start`, Topic) |>
  # mutate(`Important Dates` = paste(`Important Dates`, collapse = "<br>")) |>
  unique() |>
  summarize(`Important Dates` = if_else(is.na(`Important Dates`), NA_character_, unique(`Important Dates`))) |>
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(weeksort) |>
  mutate(Topic = if_else(Week <= 16, sprintf("<a href='https://srvanderplas.github.io/stat1080/weeks/week-%03d.html'> %s </a>", Week*10, Topic), Topic)) |>
  select(Week, Start = `Week Start`, Topic, `Important Dates`) |>
  datatable(escape = F, selection = 'none', filter='none', 
            options = list(paging = F, info = F, searching = F, ordering = F), 
                           rownames = F, style = "bootstrap") 
```
